content.thinking: Root cause is integer division: sum / n is int division before assigning to float, so fractional part lost. Need hint level 1 conceptual nudge. No code. Call give_hint once.

input.text: Think about what type C uses when you divide two int variables. When both operands are integers, C does integer division and discards the remainder before the result ever reaches a float variable. That's why values like 7/2 and 5/3 are coming out as whole numbers. You want the division itself to happen in floating-point arithmetic, not only the assignment afterward.

content.text: The failures come from integer division: `sum / n` is computed with `int` arithmetic before the result is stored in `avg`, so the fractional part is already gone by the time it's printed. I've given a level-1 nudge pointing at that concept without showing any code.
